sentences.en: One of Jupiter's moons, Io, has active volcanoes on it.
sentences.zh: 木星的一颗卫星——伊欧上有活跃的火山。

sentences.en: Mount Sakurajima is one of the world's most active volcanoes.
sentences.zh: 日本樱岛是一座世界上最活跃的火山之一。

sentences.en: There's a volcano emitting masses of smoke in Iceland.
sentences.zh: 冰岛有一座火山正在大量喷烟。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：vol（意愿）+can（会）+(n)o →火山爆发不以人的意志为转移→火山
